newsitem.title: USA: WestPoint Stevens amends SEC registration.
newsitem.headline: WestPoint Stevens amends SEC registration.

text.p: WestPoint Stevens Inc said Thursday it had filed an amendment to a registration statement covering 2.0 million shares of common stock with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
The company said the shares were owned by WPS Investors LP, an investment partnership that holds more than 11.2 million shares in WestPoint.

Before WestPoint makes the offering, WPS Investors will distribute the shares to three of its indirect institutional equity holders, who in turn will sell the shares pursuant to the registration statement, it said.
WestPoint Stevens is a home fashions consumer products company.
